interpretations: Calculate each invoice’s average non-NULL line-item `product_price`, then average those invoice averages, skipping invoices with no non-NULL prices; separately, average line-item counts across all invoices, counting invoices with no line items as zero. Return both unrounded values in one row.
queries:
WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT
    i.invoice_number,
    AVG(li.product_price) AS average_product_price,
    COUNT(li.invoice_number) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoices AS i
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li
    ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  GROUP BY i.invoice_number
)
SELECT
  AVG(average_product_price) AS average_invoice_product_price,
  AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_item_count
FROM invoice_stats
